Name: Breezy Bluffs Farm v2
Author: windvalley
Description:
[b]Overview
 
[/b]This started as a small edit to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30196]Breezy Hills Farm[/url] map, but I ended up making so many changes that it turned into its own map.  

[b]Features
[/b][list]
[*]A new farm type: does not replace any vanilla farms
[*]3 respawning hardwoods stumps on the bottom left of the map
[*]Catch-able forest fish in the southern lake and mountain fish in the northern lake 
[*]Starts with blue grass growing in the pasture 
[*]Unique starter farmhouse 
[/list][b]
Installation
 
[/b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets.
[/url]Download and then extract into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[b]
Mods Pictured
[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164?tab=description]Simple Foliage[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage - Unofficial Update for 1.6[/url]﻿
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
V 2.1.0

- Adds a config option to turn on or off the respawning stumps on the bottom left of the map

- Various minor map edits
